key.name: detection-mode
key.description: Controls when the keyboard should automatically open: 0 = Never (disabled) 1 = Touch only (recommended, opens only on touch events) 2 = Always (opens on any input event)

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Interval in milliseconds for checking text field focus. Lower values = more responsive but higher CPU usage. Recommended: 300ms (same as gjs-osk)

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Enable debug logging to system journal. Use 'journalctl -f -o cat /usr/bin/gnome-shell' to view logs.

key.name: enable-clutter-detection
key.description: Enable direct detection of Clutter.Text widgets for faster response. Recommended: enabled for native GNOME applications.
